title: OOPs_food_delivery_platform
description: Python food ordering system with both a console app and an orange-and-black Tkinter GUI. Browse restaurant menus, manage a cart, and check out with 17% GST, built on clean OOP design.

title: Roman-Urdu-Sentiment-Analysis
description: "Sentiment analysis model for Roman Urdu, fine-tuned on XLM-RoBERTa over a ~129K-sample corpus (81% accuracy). Includes a live Gradio demo — covers preprocessing, tokenization, GPU fine-tuning, and evaluation for a low-resource, code-mixed language most NLP tooling skips."

title: OOPS_Faculty_remuneration_system
description: A Python OOP mini-project simulating a Higher Education Institution's faculty remuneration system — models full-time and visiting faculty (industry-trained & inter-departmental) with polymorphic salary calculation against a fixed institute budget, via a console menu.

title: C-Open_Gl-Glut-Eid_card
description: A 2D/3D animated Eid Mubarak greeting card built using C, OpenGL, and the GLUT library.
